correctness.rationale: By exchangeability it suffices to pair each singleton indicator with the match indicator for observations 1 and 2. The singleton can coexist with that match only when the matched category is different and there is exactly one occurrence of the singleton category in the other n−2 draws. This gives the joint expectation in (5), and subtracting the product of expectations gives (1). At n=2, the singleton count is twice the no-match indicator. Uniform substitution gives the sign of n−2m including zero; for two categories and n>=3 the conditional pair count on a singleton is exactly C(n−1,2), giving the binary factor and its roots. The diagrams are scoped to the uniform and two-category models respectively. Independent exact multinomial occupation-vector enumeration in `python3 /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py 3` matched the formulas in 96 cases.
